cfp.text: Workshop on Adaptation Mechanisms in Changing Environments. A synthetic call, invented for a fixture. Topics of interest: mechanisms of in-context learning, efficient adaptation, robustness under distribution shift, and evaluation practices. Submissions are limited to 9 pages. Papers are evaluated on novelty, significance, technical quality, and clarity.
